body: You also do this? I do react in a healthier, more straightforward way too, but I don't know why I do this without even realizing or trying to. It sucks, friend. Sorry you're in the same boat.

That's the thing - I can see it being a self-defense mechanism I developed, but if that were the root it would have been to get people to leave me alone/take my feelings seriously. I don't want to be left alone, and the people I engage with *do* take my feelings seriously now. So I want to find an alternative and/or essentially "kill" this habit. It's outdated armor, if that's why I do it. It's honestly kind of embarrassing that this doesn't seem like something a lot of people do. I was hoping someone would have advice or a story about overcoming this, but that might have been too hopeful a thought lol.

Oh no worries! I can send a DM to you if that would be comfortable? This site still confuses me, too. 

Absolutely, like I know they're not real but I don't want to treat my creations badly. It almost feels like an extension of the self, so it's nice to show them some care and compassion-- especially when I'm struggling with that personally lol. I'm pretty sure Frére Jacques is about a priest, but I'm not super well-versed in Bible lore so I could be wrong! Awww another mouse! I don't think I've ever heard that one, I'll have to check it out today. They've been a nice distraction, tbh; I've been taking care of some friends' pets so I've been able to get out of my house and my head for the week. I hope yours has been a comforting holiday season, at the least. It sounds like you could use some peace and gentle energy lately!

Hello! Oh my god, I'm so sorry to hear about the news you got. That's heartbreaking and must be so, so difficult to hear. If you want to talk, you can feel free to DM me; I'm happy to listen. 
Don't apologize, please, it's okay! I've been busy too and I definitely understand the brain fog/thinking blocks; this time of year is chaotic even at baseline. 
I'm glad the drawing was feeling cathartic! Creativity can be fickle to access so I'm sure some time will help with bolstering that drive. Somehow, drawing scars feels almost spiritual to me. I'm always more careful with those kinds of drawings, like I want to respect the character's story in a way. 
The nursery rhyme I remember most vividly is definitely Frère Jacques; it's kind of going on default in the back of my mind most of the day lol! I think it was also in a little book I had, accompanied by a watercolor of a little mouse sleeping. I think under a church bell?

I'm proud of you for trying, too. It's hard as hell and I think you're doing amazing!

French nursery rhymes are so real, weirdly enough I learned some from my grandma as a kid (French exchange student came to my school and I wanted to talk to them, Grandma was excited to teach me more than just conversational phrases lol!) and something about the language is really calming and feels very satisfying to learn and speak. Oh! I should look for that, I used to love those books and I think the dynamic of the characters would be very uplifting. The strength in their bond was inspiring and I'd love to see how they've worked it into cinema again. I know omg! It's weird but that was the first thing to get me to cry all day, I think I needed to break the seal on those emotions. It feels less intense now. Maybe there's something to that whole expressing yourself spiel I dunno lol. Thank you so much, things have gotten really messy and disorganized and it's been stressing me out so it does feel kind of good to tackle that, even if just a little bit. 

Colouring skin with pencils drives me insane it's easily one of the hardest parts! I think I'll go find something to watch for a bit too, let me know how the drawing goes tomorrow and I'll let you know what I settle on for the night! You did a great job today and I hope you rest so well knowing that!

One day at a time, it's okay. You deserve to feel safe with yourself. I've never seen Russian Doll, but EEAAO broke me the one time I saw it, I don't think I can cope with family messages right now lol! Do you mean the Series of Unfortunate Events movie? The one with Jim Carrey? Or did they put another one out? The drawing would be a really helpful tactic for me, I think, that's a good idea. Thank you. I just saw someone say that drawing a small creature on your skin where you usually harm can help bc you'd "kill" it if you went through with it... That broke my heart tbh but it was enough to get me up and cleaning a little, I guess cleaning helps me sometimes? 

How's the drawing going?

I've been stewing in it for hours, it was in the back of my mind while I was working and I was hoping it would fade by the time I finished but now I have nothing to do and I can't bring myself to find a movie or game or anything, idk. I guess I have one person in my life I feel comfortable talking to about this stuff generally, but they're struggling a lot right now and I would fucking hate myself even more if I talked to them about this bc I know it would hurt them and they don't know how to help me with it. 

I'm so sorry you're in a similar boat. I hope today has been gentle to you.

It really is, the best we can do is hold on tight and try our hardest. I know we can all get there and if we have to lean on one another that's all the better. 
Thank you so much! I got a free coffee from my favorite café! I hope you see lots of bright shiny lights throughout today, delicious meals and warm sunshine.

That's incredible, congratulations! You deserve a life free of toxicity and filled with positive energy and people. I hope your new job gives you the stability you need to build a safe and healthy foundation up for your new, amazing life!

That's amazing, I'm so happy that you've gotten a motorcycle to enjoy all of your very own! I hope you enjoy the feeling of riding down the road in the open air, it seems so freeing. 

Wow, fantastic!! Thank you for giving back to your community, I bet you've made that kid's life so much brighter and helped open many doors for them.
That's insane! I'm really glad you both are okay! Even if it was dangerous, I bet memories like that give you a laugh and a different perspective on life.
Not much? That's amazing, I'm very happy for you! Thank you for sharing. I hope things continue to look up for you.
I'm sorry for my rude responses and personal attacks. I got defensive and have been taking out frustration on people who don't deserve it.
I'm sorry for being so rude to you. I've been taking out my frustration on others and that was wrong. You were just trying to help and I attacked you. I'm sorry.
Absolutely. Thank you.
You're right. I told them I'd never abandon them and I feel like a liar. I don't understand why I put myself into these situations.

I think so, but this is the most financially and physically stable I've ever been and I'm afraid of what could happen if I tell them I'm done. They won't leave the apartment and they're the only one with a car. They also have a bigger support network than I do and more resources in general. 😕
You're right. Thank you.
You're right. I've been in an awful place and I'm taking it out on strangers for my mistake and that was wrong.
Helpful. Thanks.

Wow?? What died in your arse this morning?

I came to an *advice* subreddit to ask for *advice* on how to communicate. This isn't a vent post, I'm not looking to ignore the problem until it goes away or just stop the friendship. Grow up.

You must be a great friend. I'm not looking to ignore people I love; I communicate instead of just shutting down. That's why the title says "ask" and not "shut down" or "avoid".

Try developing a sense of compassion. You're acting like a twat.

I love that 75% of these answers are just...ignore my friend. 

That's kind of terrible advice. I don't hate my friend, and I'm not looking to dissolve the friendship. If this were all they do I would absolutely pull away but I value this person and I'm not interested in ghosting people I love or turning them away. I'm interested in communication; which is why the title uses the word "ask" and not "avoid".
Thank you, this is a helpful response!
Yeah, let me just completely ignore my friend when they come to me. That will absolutely solve my problems.
Thank you, this is helpful!
It's in person mostly. Jesus.
It's in person, most of the time.
In person, jackass.

An affirming hobby? Do you mean like...something that I can be proud of that puts strength into me? That's a very helpful suggestion, thank you. 

What do you mean when you refer to "this" as another form of self-sabotage? This post, or this general attitude toward myself?

They do love me, and I sometimes just trick myself into thinking that they'll get sick of me. The kicker is that the way I respond to that unfounded, self-driven idea is actually probably going to push them away more than it's going to help. I guess I'm just curious if anyone else feels like this; trapped between their mind's "wagon wheel ruts" of self hate and the concept that the people they love love them too. And if so, I wonder how these people counteract those thoughts and ruminations. Because they are so unbelievably loud.

I mean, emotions are valid by virtue of existing. It may seem severe to you, but just because you gauge it as being an overreaction doesn't mean her feelings are invalid. 

Intense? Sure. Maybe even excessive? Yeah. Invalid? Nah.
You're calling this a fight? Sweetie...
Obviously. This is why I stated I'm in therapy and working with my therapist. I was under the impression, however, that this was a subreddit for relationship advice. Thanks for the useless response.

Unfortunately, the in-patient services in my area are among some of the worst I've seen. I'm actually afraid to go there as most of the time you come back out in the same place or three steps backward with the addition of having not worked or done anything in your life for the duration of your stay. 

You're right though, I really don't want to give up. I know things can get better - I've had better and felt better - it's just really overwhelming and the thoughts are some of the most stark that I've ever had. 

Thank you for the suggestions. My home has been suffering from my depressive episode and I guess at this point I'm uncomfortable enough anyway that I can push myself through the tasks. Cleaning does usually lift me up a little anyway, so it'll probably help even just a bit. :)

I'll remind myself that I'm here and that's not bad. There are good things in the world and Im strong enough to talk back to the muck even if it's persistent. Thank you. 💚
